apps.name: NOOP
apps.subtitle: Read your own WHOOP strap, fully offline.
apps.localizedDescription: NOOP talks to a WHOOP 4.0 / 5.0 / MG strap you own directly over Bluetooth — no WHOOP app, no subscription, no cloud. Personal fork with an added self-hosted push client and intervals.icu import.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: NOOP connects directly to your WHOOP strap over Bluetooth to read heart rate, R-R intervals, battery, and sensor data locally on your iPhone. Nothing leaves your device.
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: NOOP reads your own Apple Health data on-device to compute recovery, strain, and sleep. Nothing leaves your device.
privacy.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: NOOP writes the metrics it computes from your strap back into Apple Health, on-device and only when you allow it.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NOOP records your route during an outdoor workout to show distance, pace, and a map, and keeps recording while the screen is off. The route stays on your device. Nothing leaves it.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: NOOP reads your iPhone's step count for a walking or running workout to show steps in the activity summary. It stays on your device. Nothing leaves it.

apps.versionDescription: intervals.icu activities (any sport, not just rides) now pull in automatically after every strap sync, instead of only on a manual "Importer maintenant" tap.

versions.localizedDescription: intervals.icu activities (any sport, not just rides) now pull in automatically after every strap sync, instead of only on a manual "Importer maintenant" tap.

Merged upstream NOOP v12.0.0 (Today ring redraw/perf cleanup, Key Metrics view, consistent day-swipe, WHOOP 4.0 direct BLE HR broadcast, personal daytime-stress baseline, LF/HF ratio parity fix, sleep-detect honesty fix, 10th language). Fork tuning on top: Effort's Edwards zone cut-offs raised +5 points so ordinary daytime HR no longer scores a visible Effort while real workouts are barely affected; sleep-onset HR margin tightened from 5% to 2% above the night's own median so a still-but-awake stretch is less likely to be counted as asleep.

Fork build: sleep onset now requires HR to also settle toward its sleep-level baseline, not just stillness; Coach (AI) now always replies in French; intervals.icu Activities on Today capped to the 2 most recent with a See all link.

Fork build: reverted the HR-based auto-save-without-confirmation (it created false-positive workouts); intervals.icu-imported activities now appear in the main Workouts list; the intervals.icu activities + AI-debrief list moved from More onto Today, right below Your Cards.

Fork build: Auto-detect workouts is now fully automatic (saves straight to Workouts, no confirmation card, no settings toggle); detection thresholds loosened (8-min sustained, 180s dip tolerance); opt-in overload alert; AI debrief per intervals.icu activity using your Coach API key; Effort ring recovery-based target band.

Fork build: Effort ring now shows a recovery-based target band; new opt-in overload alert (3-day streak above optimal range); intervals.icu bidirectional sync (real per-sample HR import + wellness push + dedicated Activities screen); morning sleep recap notification (bedtime, alarm quality, early-night recovery, night explainer); HRV/sleep trend + post-workout nutrition nudges; Pace of Recovery, Race Time Predictor, Fasting Window, Resilience score; Energy Budget widget; more sensitive Charge/Recovery scoring; symmetric sleep onset/final-wake persistence.
Fork build: 10-minute sleep-onset window (was 90s) + self-hosted push client + intervals.icu import.
